title: Local unramified criterion for essentially finite type algebras
statement: Let $R\to V$ be a local homomorphism of commutative local rings, meaning that the inverse image of the maximal ideal $\mathfrak m_V$ is $\mathfrak m_R$. Assume that $V$ is essentially of finite type over $R$ [def-weil-pbc-essentially-finite-type-algebra]. Then $\Omega_{V/R}=0$ [def-weil-pbc-kahler-differentials] if and only if the induced residue field extension $(V/\mathfrak m_V)/(R/\mathfrak m_R)$ is separable algebraic [def-weil-pbc-separable-algebraic-extension] and $\mathfrak m_RV=\mathfrak m_V$. Here $\mathfrak m_RV$ is the ideal generated by the image of $\mathfrak m_R$.
